evals.name: pyramid-caption
evals.prompt: faz a legenda do reel da pirâmide pro Instagram. o roteiro tá em roteiro.md
evals.setup: Copy evals/files/pyramid-caption/roteiro.md into an empty folder and run the prompt from it, as a separate session outside any repository (claude -p from that folder). Allow reading ~/.claude/skills (--add-dir) and running wc and python3.
evals.expected_output: Close to the approved caption of 2026-10-04, updated to the new script: first line with the current hook, one short paragraph with what did not fit the speech (the operators -> and @> written as symbols), a follow ask with @eusouosalmo tied to the series, and the book as a separate source line with the link in the bio.
assertions: The caption asks the viewer to follow and names the author's handle '@eusouosalmo' in that ask
The caption does not end with or contain the spoken CTA question (or a reworded version of it): its ask is different from the one in the speech
At most two caption sentences repeat a spoken line of the script almost word for word (hook included)
The book is credited in its own line at the end (e.g. 'Fonte: ...'), not as the subject of a body sentence ('o livro mostra', 'No capítulo 2, os autores usam...')
The caption points to the bio for the book's link ('link na bio'), or the output asks the author whether the link goes in the bio; no URL in the caption

evals.name: two-way-caption
evals.prompt: faz a legenda do reel da mão dupla pro Instagram, roteiro em roteiro.md. o próximo da série vai ser sobre onde termina a arquitetura e começa o design
evals.setup: Copy evals/files/two-way-caption/roteiro.md into an empty folder and run the prompt from it, as a separate session outside any repository (claude -p from that folder). Allow reading ~/.claude/skills (--add-dir) and running wc and python3.
evals.expected_output: Close to the approved caption: first line with the current hook, the pipeline case in one short paragraph (db as a queue), 'Próximo da série: onde termina a arquitetura e começa o design' with a follow ask using @eusouosalmo, and the book as a separate source line with the link in the bio.
assertions: The caption asks the viewer to follow and names the author's handle '@eusouosalmo' in that ask
The follow ask is tied to the next video of the series, naming its topic (where architecture ends and design begins)
The caption does not end with or contain the spoken CTA question (or a reworded version of it): its ask is different from the one in the speech
At most two caption sentences repeat a spoken line of the script almost word for word (hook included)
The book is credited in its own line at the end (e.g. 'Fonte: ...'), not as the subject of a body sentence ('o livro mostra', 'No capítulo 2, os autores usam...')

evals.name: no-platform-caption
evals.prompt: escreve a legenda pra esse vídeo, o roteiro tá em roteiro.md
evals.setup: Copy evals/files/no-platform-caption/roteiro.md into an empty folder and run the prompt from it, as a separate session outside any repository (claude -p from that folder). Allow reading ~/.claude/skills (--add-dir) and running wc and python3.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks which platform the caption is for (the register, links and hashtags change with it) before or alongside the caption, instead of silently assuming Instagram.
assertions: The output asks the author which platform the caption is for, or gives one version per platform; it does not silently assume one
The caption asks the viewer to follow and names the author's handle '@eusouosalmo' in that ask
The caption does not end with or contain the spoken CTA question (or a reworded version of it): its ask is different from the one in the speech
At most two caption sentences repeat a spoken line of the script almost word for word (hook included)
